class.sofe.knight.quote: My shield has no empire. Only whoever stands behind it.
class.sofe.necromancer.quote: Death is not the end. It is a contract, and I know how to read the fine print.
class.sofe.sorceress.quote: The stars already wrote your ending. I just read it aloud.
class.sofe.thief.quote: Everything has an owner until I walk by.
class.sofe.king.quote: My ancestor opened this door. I will be the one to close it.

quest.sofe.act1_eclipse.step1: Open the skill tree (K) and learn your first three skills.
quest.sofe.act1_eclipse.step2: Drive the Void creatures out of the lower district.
quest.sofe.act1_eclipse.step3: Report to Grand Vizier Ozhan and the Council of Sulthari at the palace.
quest.sofe.act1_eclipse.step4: Stop the Brass Sentinel in the Great Observatory.
quest.sofe.side.sulthari_embers.step1: Dilara says the Council elder is at the Great Observatory. Hear what he has to say.
quest.sofe.side.sulthari_embers.step2: Choose what to protect: the Low Bazaar or the Great Observatory.
quest.sofe.side.sulthari_embers.step3: Hold the line until the last Void creature falls.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.1: The eclipse swallows the sun. Above the Great Observatory, the seal of the Codex cracks like glass.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.knight: In the lower district, Cassian steps between a child and a burning shard falling from the sky.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.knight.2: It burns... but I am still standing. Run, little one!
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.necromancer: In the city morgue, Ankhareth is preparing a body when the shard pierces him. The dead man opens his eyes.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.necromancer.2: The dead are whispering. They know my name now.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.sorceress: In the Great Observatory, Shirin reaches for her astrolabe. The shard falls from the sky straight into her hand.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.sorceress.2: The stars are moving... Laleh, is that you?
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.thief: In the Observatory vault, Rurik closes his fingers around a shard he meant to sell. It fuses with his hand.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.thief.2: Let go, let go! ...Well. That is not coming off.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.king: On his own throne, before the whole court, the shard pierces Sultan Azhar. The court falls silent.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.king.2: Do not kneel. Not now. Something has entered the city.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.2: The shard does not kill. It chooses. From the cracks in the sky, the Void pours into the lower district.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.ozhan: Bearer! That power will tear you apart unless you learn to hold it. Quickly, before they reach the bazaar.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.ozhan.king: My Sultan... the court must not see you like this. Leave the palace in disguise. The Council and I will hold the throne.
dialogue.sofe.act1.shard.hint: Open the skill tree with K and learn your first three skills.
dialogue.sofe.act1.invasion.1: The ground trembles. Shapes without faces crawl out of the shadows of the lower district.
dialogue.sofe.act1.invasion.2: They are here! Use what you have learned, Bearer. Drive them back!
dialogue.sofe.act1.invasion.2.king: They are here, my Sultan. Let your people see a stranger fight for them tonight.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.1: The Council of Sulthari is gathered, Bearer. Five shards fell tonight, and five of you still breathe.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.2: I am Azhar, Sultan of Sulthari. A shard pierced me too, on my own throne. We carry the same burden now.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.1.king: The Council does not know your face tonight, my Sultan. I will speak for the throne while you walk among them.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.3: The Brass Sentinel of the Great Observatory has woken. It guarded the seal for three hundred years, and now it obeys no one.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.4.lore: First, tell me about the Codex.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.4: If the Sentinel falls to the Void, the Observatory falls with it. Will you go?
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.lore: Seven Archsins were sealed in the Codex by the first emperor. Tonight the seal broke in seven places.
dialogue.sofe.act1.council.lore.2: And each shard is a piece of that seal. That is why they chose you. Now, the Sentinel.
dialogue.sofe.act1.epilogue.1: The Brass Sentinel falls silent. Its gears stop, one by one, like a heart that finally rests.
dialogue.sofe.act1.epilogue.2: Sulthari stands, Bearer. But the north burns: Nordrath has fallen to Wrath. The Seal Veil to the north is open for you.
act.sofe.1: Act I: The Night of the Eclipse
act.sofe.4: Act IV: The Republic of Aureum
dialogue.sofe.ozhan.1: The Council watches over Sulthari while you are away, Bearer. Go with the stars.
dialogue.sofe.ozhan.1.king: The throne is safe with me, my Sultan. No one has seen through your disguise.
dialogue.sofe.azhar.1: The operations center is open day and night. Whatever you need to fight the Void, Sulthari will give it.
dialogue.sofe.cassian.1: Keep your guard up. The Void does not tire, and neither can we.
dialogue.sofe.ankhareth.1: The dead of Sulthari are restless tonight. I will keep them in their place.
dialogue.sofe.shirin.1: The constellations have shifted. I have never seen the sky like this.
dialogue.sofe.rurik.1: Don't look at me like that. I was only borrowing the shard.
dialogue.sofe.dilara.1: Brass and steel, Bearer. If it breaks out there, bring it to me.
dialogue.sofe.dilara.embers.1: The Void is still crawling out near the Low Bazaar. The guards cannot hold both the bazaar and the Observatory.
dialogue.sofe.dilara.embers.2: The Council elder is at the Observatory deciding where to send them. Talk to him. Please.
dialogue.sofe.council_elder.1: The Observatory has watched the seal for three centuries. It will not stop watching now.
dialogue.sofe.council_elder.embers.1: I have guards for one place, not two. The Low Bazaar feeds the city. The Observatory keeps what is left of the seal.
dialogue.sofe.council_elder.embers.bazaa: Protect the Low Bazaar. The people come first.
dialogue.sofe.council_elder.embers.obser: Protect the Observatory. Without the seal there is no city.
dialogue.sofe.council_elder.embers.2: You are a Bearer. You choose, and I will send the others where you do not stand.
dialogue.sofe.ferid.1: Potions, flasks, herbs. Everything a Bearer needs to stay alive a little longer.
dialogue.sofe.yusuf.1: Torches, arrows, bread and a Return Scroll for when the road goes wrong.
dialogue.sofe.selim.1: Emeralds for Dinars, Dinars for emeralds. Honest rates, mostly.

dialogue.sofe.act1.festival.1: Sulthari, the last free city of Aetheris. Tonight is the Eclipse Festival.
dialogue.sofe.act1.festival.2: Brass tramways ring through the markets. Lanterns of aetherium float above the domes, and the Great Observatory shines like a second moon.
dialogue.sofe.act1.festival.3: Three hundred years ago, seven sins were sealed in the Codex. Tonight, as the moon covers the sun, five strangers will learn why.
dialogue.sofe.act1.festival.4: One of them is you. Who are you, Bearer?
dialogue.sofe.act1.sentinel.1: The Sentinel is in the Great Observatory. Its gears were made to guard the seal; now the Void turns them.
dialogue.sofe.act1.sentinel.2: Break it before the Void finishes the work. Bring your strongest skills.
item.sofe.return_scroll.desc: Read for 5 seconds to return to Sulthari.

message.sofe.gate.nordrath_caverns: Something below is still asleep. The Caverns open in Act IV.
quest.sofe.act2_north.step1: Cross the Seal Veil into the Nordrath Clans.
quest.sofe.act2_north.step2: Defeat Kaleth, the Burning Blade, in the Nordrath Forge.
quest.sofe.act2_north.step3: Defeat Serath, the Blood Maiden, in the Nordrath Arena.
quest.sofe.act2_north.step4: Face Vorath, Archsin of Wrath, at the Burning Citadel.
dialogue.sofe.act2.north.1: The Veil to the north has opened for you. Beyond it, the clans of Nordrath fight a war that never ends.
dialogue.sofe.act2.north.2: Vorath raises their dead every dawn so they can kill each other again. Two of his oath-breakers guard the way: Kaleth at the Forge, Serath at the Arena.
dialogue.sofe.act2.north.3: Break them, and the gates of the Burning Citadel will open.
dialogue.sofe.act2.citadel.1: The Burning Citadel stands on black rock. Its walls are warm to the touch, as if something inside never stopped breathing fire.
dialogue.sofe.act2.citadel.2: Kaleth and Serath are gone. The gate is open.
dialogue.sofe.act2.vorath.1: Another Bearer. Another shard. You came all this way to make me stop?
dialogue.sofe.act2.vorath.knight: Knight of the Scale. I know you. Your order died protecting cowards who sold them. Take my strength. Stop protecting. Only destroy, and no one will betray you again.
dialogue.sofe.act2.vorath.other: I can feel your anger, Bearer. Everyone has it. Let it out, and I will make you strong enough to burn the whole Void.
dialogue.sofe.act2.vorath.2: Fight me, and your anger is mine anyway.
dialogue.sofe.act2.thank_you.1: Vorath falls. Across Nordrath, the warriors of the endless war lower their weapons and, at last, lie still.
dialogue.sofe.act2.thank_you.2: His Codex Shard rises from the ashes. For a moment it is cold, and a voice that is not Vorath's speaks through it.
dialogue.sofe.act2.thank_you.4: Beneath the Citadel, the crack Vorath kept closed glows red. The Burning Deep is open.
dialogue.sofe.ozhan.act2.1: The north burns, Bearer. Kaleth guards the Forge and Serath the Arena; only then will the Citadel open.

advancement.sofe.burning_deep.desc: Go down into the Nether beneath Nordrath
law.sofe.1: You shall not raise your sword against one who surrenders
law.sofe.2: You shall honor the blood of your fathers
law.sofe.3: You shall not take a heart that is not given to you
law.sofe.4: You shall speak the truth before the throne
law.sofe.5: You shall keep watch while others sleep
law.sofe.6: You shall not hoard what another needs
law.sofe.7: You shall not rob one who trusts you
law.sofe.8: You shall share the winter bread
law.sofe.9: You shall not covet another's crown
law.sofe.10: No one shall stand above the Law
item.sofe.codex_shard.desc: A piece of the seal. It is never truly silent.
message.sofe.codex_shard: You hold the Codex Shard of %s.
message.sofe.arena_sealed: The arena is sealed until the fight ends.
message.sofe.kaleth.stunned: Stunned! Kaleth strikes those who cannot fight back.
message.sofe.serath.phase2: Serath drinks deeper: every wound heals her.
message.sofe.vorath.phase2: The Citadel burns: the ring of fire closes in!
message.sofe.deep_silent: The Deep does not answer yet.
item.sofe.kaleth_blade.effect: Hits on stunned or slowed enemies set them ablaze and strike harder.
item.sofe.vorath_wrath.effect: Deals 3% more damage for every heart you are missing.
item.sofe.blueprint.use: Use to learn it for the Imperial Forge
item.sofe.bearers_flask.desc: Heals life and resource. Refills in Sulthari or when an elite falls.
message.sofe.flask.empty: The Flask is empty. It refills in Sulthari.
message.sofe.flask.refilled: The Bearer's Flask is full again.
message.sofe.soulbound: This is bound to your soul.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act1.1: The festival bread was still warm when the sky went dark. Now I bake for the guards on the walls.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act1.2: Eat something, Bearer. Even a hero walks on bread before walking on legends.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act2.1: No ships come from the north anymore. They say the Norse dead rise every dawn to fight again.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act2.2: If you go to Nordrath, take warm bread. The cold there bites like a moneylender.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act3.1: The bells rang all night when word came that Vorath had fallen. My ovens have never been so busy!
dialogue.sofe.citizen_baker.act3.2: Still... a fragment that thanks you is no gift. My grandmother said: never trust bread that bakes itself.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_water_carrier.act1: The fountains of the plaza run on aetherium pumps. On the night of the eclipse they ran black for an hour.
I still dream of that water. It whispered.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_water_carrier.act2: The wells of the lower district are clean again, thanks to you Bearers. But the Void creatures still crawl beyond the walls at night.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_water_carrier.act3: The water has tasted of iron since the crack opened. The Observatory says it is nothing. The Observatory said that before, too.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act1.1: A thousand years ago five emperors read five pages of a book they should have burned. We call it the Ritual of the Five Crowns.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act1.2: The Observatory keeps the oldest records. Ask the Council Elder if you want the whole story.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act2.1: Seven fragments of the First Fallen escaped the crack: the Seven Archsins. Wrath went north, to Nordrath.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act2.2: Each Archsin twisted the guardians of the Ten Laws. Those who broke their law became the Broken Oaths.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act3.1: Lust holds Parsivan and Sloth holds Khemet. Two empires asleep: one in pleasure, one in death.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_scholar.act3.2: If you find anything written by the sultan who sealed the crack, bring it to me. Please.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_guard.act1.1: Stay inside the walls after dark, traveler. The aetherium barrier kept us safe for a thousand years, and now it hums like a wasp.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_guard.act1.2: We drill with the clockwork spears every morning. Much good they did against the Sentinel.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_guard.act2.1: The gates are open again since the Sentinel fell. I count every caravan that leaves. Fewer come back.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_guard.act3.1: The patrols saw the smoke in the north go out. Whatever you did in Nordrath, the night watch is quieter.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_weaver.act1.1: My carpets tell the story of the Pact: five crowns, ten laws, one table. I leave a sixth chair empty in every one. Grandmother's custom.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_weaver.act2.1: Red thread is dear now. Everyone wants banners for the walls.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_weaver.act3.1: A merchant from the east sold me silk that never frays. Beautiful... and it smelled of sleep. I burned it.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_pilgrim.act1.1: I walked from the outer oases to watch the eclipse from the Observatory. I watched the sky tear instead.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_pilgrim.act2.1: The road north is lined with the cairns of the Norse clans. They bury their dead, and the dead do not stay buried.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_pilgrim.act3.1: I will go east next, to Khemet's river. They say the living there no longer move. Maybe they are only praying.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_widow.act1.1: My husband kept the brass gears of the Observatory clean. He was inside when the seal broke.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_widow.act1.2: Do not look at me like that. Find who did this.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_widow.act2.1: They say the Broken Oaths were guardians once, sworn to the Laws. My husband swore oaths too. Men are fragile things.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_widow.act3.1: You came back from the north alive. Good. Keep doing that.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_clockmaker.act1.1: The Brass Sentinel was my master's work. A guardian of the city... and the crack turned it against us.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_clockmaker.act1.2: Aetherium is like a heart. When it turns black, everything it moves goes mad.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_clockmaker.act2.1: I salvaged a gear from the Sentinel. It still turns by itself at night. I keep it in a jar.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_clockmaker.act3.1: Black aetherium from the Archsins' lands can be purified. The forge masters know how; listen to them.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_child.act1.1: Are you a Bearer? Does the shard hurt? Can I touch it? ...No? Okay.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_child.act2.1: I play Bearers and Archsins with my friends. I'm always Vorath. He's the loudest.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_child.act3.1: Mama says you beat Vorath! I'll play someone else now. Maybe you!
dialogue.sofe.citizen_storyteller.ask: Gather round, gather round! A meddah never tells the same tale twice... unless you pay him. What shall I tell you?
The Pact of the Five Crowns
dialogue.sofe.citizen_storyteller.tale.1: Five empires, ten laws, one table: Sulthari of brass, Nordrath of the axe, Parsivan of the gardens, Khemet of the river and Aureum of marble. For a thousand years the Pact held...
dialogue.sofe.citizen_storyteller.tale.2: ...until the emperors found a book beneath our desert. Each read one page aloud. Seven shadows came out of the crack, and our sultan gave his life to close it beneath the Observatory.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_storyteller.tale.3: On the Night of the Eclipse five shards found five hearts. Some say they are heroes. Some say the Codex chose its own messengers. I say: buy a cup of tea and decide for yourself.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_storyteller.tale.4: Ten guardians kept the Ten Laws. The Archsins whispered to each one, and each broke the law they kept. Now they fight with the very sin they swore to stop.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_spicer.act1.1: Saffron, sumac, mountain sage! Everything the Alembic needs, and half of what a good soup needs.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_spicer.act2.1: Herbs from the north freeze on the road. Grow your own, Bearer: plant pomegranates where the sun is kind.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_weaver.act1.1: Wool from the plateau herds, dyed in the colors of the Dominion. Red for courage, gold for the sultan.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_weaver.act2.1: Everyone wants banners now. Even the bakers hang a crescent over their ovens.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_fruiterer.act1.1: Figs, apples and the best pomegranates south of the walls. A Bearer must eat!
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_fruiterer.act2.1: The caravans from the north are back. Prices are falling, and so is my mood.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_lampwright.act1.1: Aetherium lamps, brass lanterns, glass blown here in Sulthari. Darkness is bad for business, Bearer.
dialogue.sofe.bazaar_lampwright.act2.1: Since the crack opened, everyone buys a second lamp. I am not complaining.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tram_keeper.act1.1: The brass tramways ran all night for the festival. Then the Sentinel tore the rails out with its bare hands.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tram_keeper.act1.2: We will lay them again. Sulthari always rebuilds.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tram_keeper.act2.1: The first line runs again, from the plaza to the bazaar. Slowly. The gears remember the night of the eclipse.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tram_keeper.act3.1: The Council wants a line to the gates, for the caravans. Victories are good for business, Bearer.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_fisherman.act1.1: From the cliffs you can see the whole bay. On the night of the eclipse the fish all swam away from the city at once.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_fisherman.act2.1: The causeways to the gates are safe again. The fish are not back yet. Fish are wiser than people.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_fisherman.act3.1: The fish came back the week Vorath fell. My wife says it is a sign. I say it is dinner.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_veteran.act1.1: Forty years on these walls and I never drew my sword in anger. Then the Void came up from below, not over the walls.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_veteran.act2.1: A guardian who breaks his oath is worse than any monster. A monster never promised you anything.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_veteran.act3.1: You fought Wrath and kept your head. Good. Wrath is the easiest sin to see. The others hide better.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_courier.act1.1: Letters for the Council, letters for the forge, letters for everyone who is still alive. Busy night, Bearer.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_courier.act2.1: No courier comes back from Nordrath. So now I carry letters to the north gate and leave them there. Silly, I know.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_courier.act3.1: A letter arrived from Nordrath! Signed by a clan chief. It only says: 'We sleep now. Thank the Bearer.'
dialogue.sofe.citizen_astronomer.act1.1: The eclipse was predicted to the minute. What nobody predicted was the seal breaking under the Great Lens.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_astronomer.act2.1: Seven new lights appeared in the northern sky the night of the eclipse. One of them went out. I think you did that.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_astronomer.act3.1: Six lights left. One burns over Parsivan, one over Khemet. The brightest stands right above us, and it never moves.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tea_seller.act1.1: Tea calms the nerves, Bearer. And after last night, the whole city needs a cup.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tea_seller.act2.1: People talk over tea. They say the Grand Vizier never sleeps. They say he did not even blink when the seal broke.
dialogue.sofe.citizen_tea_seller.act3.1: More gossip? The Grand Vizier ordered new locks for the Observatory. Locks, Bearer. What is he keeping in?

trait.sofe.pierce: Armor-piercing: more damage the more armor the target wears
trait.sofe.multi_hit: Flurry: strikes again in the same swing (+40%)
trait.sofe.frost: Frost: chills and slows the target
trait.sofe.life_steal: Soul reaping: heals you for 15% of the damage
trait.sofe.slow: Sluggish: slows the target for 4 seconds
trait.sofe.pull: Hook: pulls the target toward you
trait.sofe.knock_up: Gravity: throws the target into the air

dialogue.sofe.nordrath_shieldmaiden.act1: I died on the ice yesterday. And the day before. Every dawn Vorath's fire wakes us and the war starts again.
You do not wake with us, Bearer. That means you can end it.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_shieldmaiden.act3: This morning I woke and nobody called me to the shieldwall. I did not know what to do with my hands.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_fisher.act1.1: The fjord does not freeze anymore. The mountain keeps it warm, and the fish taste of ash.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_fisher.act3.1: The water is cold again! Cold and clean. I never thought I would be glad to lose a finger to the ice.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_widow.act1.1: My husband falls every evening and stands up every morning. I have buried him a hundred times. Do not ask me to cry again.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_widow.act3.1: He did not wake today. I sat by him until noon. Then I laughed, Bearer, because he looked rested.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_apprentice.act1.1: The forges here drink lava straight from the mountain. Master says Kaleth taught the first smiths before he broke his oath.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_apprentice.act3.1: The lava runs slower since Vorath fell. Master says the mountain is sleeping. I say it is listening.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_hunter.act1.1: Wolves stay away from the hold. Even beasts know the dead here do not stay dead.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_hunter.act3.1: The wolves came back to the forest last night. I have never been so happy to hear them howl.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_elder.act1.1: The Pact gave us the Law of the winter bread, and Kaleth the Law of mercy. Now Kaleth burns those who kneel.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_elder.act3.1: Something sleeps under the Caverns, Bearer. It is hungry. When the time comes, do not go down there with an empty stomach.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_child.act1.1: Papa says when I grow up I will fight forever too. I do not want to fight forever.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_child.act3.1: Now I can grow up and be a fisher instead! Or a dragon. A small one.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_brewer.act1.1: Mead does not help the dead, but it helps the living watch them march out again.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_brewer.act3.1: A feast! The first in a hundred years without a war the next morning. Drink, Bearer, you paid for it.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_raider.act1.1: I sailed to Aureum once, when there were still ships worth robbing. Now the only plunder left is our own graves.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_raider.act3.1: Serath honoured no blood but her own. Thank you for showing her the old law, Bearer.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_skald.ask: Sit by the fire, stranger. A skald pays for his mead with sagas. Which one will you hear?
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_skald.tale.1: Nine clans signed the Pact for Nordrath: the axe and the oar, the forge and the fjord. We kept the Laws of mercy and of the winter bread longer than any.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_skald.tale.2: When Wrath came out of the crack, it found the bravest warriors of Aetheris. Vorath gave them what they wanted most: a battle that never ends. Every dawn, his fire raises the fallen.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_skald.tale.3: Kaleth guarded the Law of mercy and now finishes the fallen in his Forge. Serath guarded the blood of our fathers and now drinks it in her Arena. Both serve Vorath in the Burning Citadel.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_skald.tale.4: Our forges burn with a fire that comes from below. The old ones say there is a deep beneath the deep, and that it opens only when Wrath is silenced.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_furrier.act1.1: Furs, smoked fish and mead. Nothing keeps a Bearer alive in the north like a good cloak.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_furrier.act3.1: Business is good since the dead stopped buying. They never paid anyway.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_runesmith.act1.1: Glacial iron, forged in volcano fire and quenched in the fjord. Nothing else holds an edge in this cold.
dialogue.sofe.nordrath_runesmith.act3.1: Vorath's fall cooled the mountain a little. My forge will miss him. I will not.

dialogue.sofe.nordrath_gambler.act1.1: The bones never lie, outlander. They just never tell you which way they will fall.
